I could not derive this independently, so the verdict rests on a recollection that I could not confirm.

The solution gives only the number 3 and shows no argument for it. As I remember, the literature on 4-vertex-critical $(P_7,C_3)$-free graphs says that exactly 2 such graphs contain an induced $C_7$. I am not certain of this memory, and I did not check it by enumeration. Because it conflicts with the claimed 3 and nothing in the proposed solution supports 3, I do not accept the answer.

VERDICT: REJECT
